episodes.title: umbraCoffee #037 - Shhh... Unicorner is around the corner!
episodes.summary: Covers the return of the Unicorner, 86 PRs merged in July, the August uProfile and Skrift issue 40. Also covers the PL Festival schedule, DE Fest call for papers, a code block property editor and the Umbraco Cloud agency story from The Cogworks.

episodes.summary: Covers umbracoTee day, the second v8 hackathon and CMS Critic Awards nominations, and several blogs on v8 NuCache and Serilog. Also covers new releases, festival speakers, the Umbraco BBQ schedule, a second virtual meetup and new HQ hires.

episodes.summary: Covers the Umbraco 7.11.0 release, uBenchmark results from Offroad Code and more love for the docs. Also covers meetups, the virtual meetup summary, new package releases such as Fluidity, a Lego Mindstorms headless idea and Formulate passing 500 commits.

episodes.title: umbraCoffee #029 - Meetups and the V8 event horizon
episodes.summary: Covers meetups, v8 hackathons, Umbraco training news and the Anders Bjerner uProfile. Also covers super-early bird Codegarden tickets, Warren's lightning talk on Examine, tips for Latch, the Umbraco hall of fame and a blog on the v8 event horizon.

episodes.summary: Post-Codegarden 2018 roundup, with summaries from Umbraco HQ and the videos being published. Also covers community meetups, the Umbraco v8 discussions, the Cogworks v8 hackathon, the CPR team introduction and new package releases.

episodes.summary: The umbraCoffee YouTube milestone and Umbraco 7.9.3 and 7.10.0, with Sebastiaan Janssen and Anders Bjerner. Also covers a feature request about overwriting other editors' work, the Our Umbraco upgrades, the PL Festival call for speakers and Codegarden day 2.

episodes.summary: Umbraco 7.9 and GDPR, with Lee Kelleher talking about UMCO, CODECABIN and the Bristol user group. Also covers Codegarden's first speakers, the HQ hackathon and new CONTRIBUTING.md, the new download page and uSync and Translation Manager releases.

episodes.summary: Welcoming new members of the Umbraco D-team. Covers the chosen installer screen, Umbraco meetups in Edinburgh, Denmark and Belgium, the Council of the European Union case study, package releases, feature requests and CODECABIN registration.

episodes.summary: Mike Masey on his pull requests to Umbraco Core. Also covers the return of uProfile, nominations for the 2018 Umbraco Awards, WebVR with Umbraco, Umbraco 7.7.8, package releases and a new online certification course.

episodes.title: umbraCoffee #006 - Wind of Change
episodes.summary: New Umbraco D-team employees and Niels' New Year memo about Headless and v8 in 2018, with Pete Duncanson. Also covers Spectre and Meltdown on Umbraco Cloud, Skrift issue 33, the Fluidity release and early bird uDuf tickets.

episodes.summary: A look back at 2017 and forward to 2018 with Rune Strand. Covers the year's Umbraco releases and features, v8 appearing on the tracker and the Umbraco festivals held across the world.

episodes.summary: Umbraco training discounts, worldwide festivals and community news. Covers Skrift posts, 24 Days articles, a new starter kit from Paul Seal, a v8 sneak peek, umbMapper and the launch of umbracofestival.com.
